test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Change the following sentence into the Active form.

The new law was passed by the parliament.

options.text: The new law passed the parliament.
The parliament passes the new law.
The parliament passed the new law.
The new law has been passed by the parliament.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• To change the sentence from passive to active voice, identify the subject, verb, and object in the passive sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, "The new law was passed by the parliament," the subject is "the parliament," the verb is "passed," and the object is "the new law."
 
• Rearrange the sentence so that the subject ("the parliament") comes first, followed by the verb ("passed"), and then the object ("the new law").
 
• Ensure that the verb tense remains consistent. In this case, "was passed" in the passive voice becomes "passed" in the active voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The parliament passed the new law."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The new law passed the parliament." – Incorrect as the subject-verb agreement is not logical in this context.
 
• **Option 2: **"The parliament passes the new law." – Incorrect tense; the original sentence is in the past tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"The new law has been passed by the parliament." – This is still in the passive voice and in the present perfect tense, not the active voice.

3f:T
